stem: The author suggests that Generation Z should

options.text: be careful in choosing a college.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 偷换概念】讨论的是要不要读大学的根本价值抉择，非如何选大学选校。

options.text: be diligent at each educational stage.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 泛化勤奋】文章讨论的是对高等教育必要性的理性审视，非空泛劝勉勤奋刻苦。

options.text: reassess the necessity of college education.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 同义替换】P1-S1 和 P3-S1 明确阐明作者给年轻人的核心建议：'worth considering just how the point, purpose and value of a degree has changed... stress that a degree is not for everyone... other options are available'（值得深思学位的宗旨和价值发生了何种转变，强调大学并非适合所有人，存在其他出路）。C选项 reassess the necessity of college education（重新审视大学教育的必要性）是对全文开篇核心主旨最精准的概括。

options.text: postpone their undergraduate application.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 歪曲建议】作者是建议理性权衡其他出路，非建议单纯推迟延迟申请。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: weigh up options + value of degree changed + degree not for everyone = reassess the necessity of college education。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 主旨建议题定位：抓准 value of degree changed 与 degree is not for everyone 对应的 reassess necessity of college education。

stem: The percentage of UK graduates in non-graduate roles reflects

options.text: Millennials' opinions about work.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 概念错配】千禧一代曾深信好文凭保一生，该数据反映的是客观劳动力市场文凭贬值现实，非主观工作观念。

options.text: the shrinking value of a degree.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 同义替换】P2-S1 和 P2-S2 紧密相连：'As degrees became universal, they became devalued. Education was no longer a secure route... Today, 28 percent of graduates in the UK are in non-graduate roles'（随着文凭普及，学位发生严重贬值，高等教育不再稳妥……如今28%的毕业生在做无需学历的岗位）。28%的数据正是用以直接证明文凭严重贬值、含金量大幅缩水（the shrinking value of a degree）。B选项完全精准吻合。

options.text: public discontent with education.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 情绪泛化】文章强调的是文凭经济回报率的客观下降，非公众对教育的不满情绪。

options.text: the desired route of social mobility.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 事实相反】文中文凭已经不再是阶层上升的稳妥通道（no longer a secure route of social mobility）。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: degrees became universal, they became devalued + 28% in non-graduate roles = the shrinking value of a degree。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 数据例证论点对应：抓准 28% in non-graduate roles 前句论点 degrees became devalued（文凭贬值）。

stem: The author considers it a good sign that

options.text: Generation Z are seeking to earn a decent degree.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 事实相反】好文凭神话已经破灭，Z 世代正在从盲目追求文凭的旧思维中清醒过来。

options.text: school leavers are willing to be skilled workers.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 偷换主体】作者肯定的是雇主看重其忠诚度并取消文凭限制的理性用人观，非中学毕业生的就业意愿。

options.text: employers are taking a realistic attitude to degrees.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 同义替换】P4-S1 和 P4-S2 明确指出令人欣慰的良好迹象：'Thankfully, there are signs that this is already happening... Employers have long seen the advantages of hiring school leavers... seeing advantages of scrapping a degree requirement for certain roles'（雇主早已发现直接招收中学毕业生的忠诚优势，发现取消某些岗位文凭要求的巨大好处）。C选项 employers are taking a realistic attitude to degrees（雇主正在对大学文凭采取更加务实清醒的理性态度）是对这一转变最精准的概括。

options.text: parents are changing their minds about education.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 事实完全相反】家长和老师依然顽固沉溺于文凭思维定式中（parents still set in degree mindset）。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: Thankfully... Employers see advantages of hiring school leavers and scrapping degree requirement = employers taking a realistic attitude to degrees。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 积极信号题提取：抓准 Thankfully 后阐述的雇主破除唯学历论的用人转变（realistic attitude）。

stem: It is advised in Paragraph 5 that those with one degree should

options.text: make an early decision on their career.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 偏离建议】第五段专讲继续深造提升专门知识，非尽早决定职业。

options.text: attend on-the-job training programs.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 偷换概念】建议的是攻读研究生学位（Postgraduates / have two degrees），非在职培训课程。

options.text: team up with high-paid postgraduates.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 荒谬错误】是建议自己成为高收入的研究生（Postgraduates earn 40% more），非与研究生组队。

options.text: further their studies in a specific field.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 同义替换】P5-S1 明确向本科学位持有者给出建议：'In this age of generalists, it pays to have specific knowledge or skills. Postgraduates now earn 40 percent more than graduates. When more and more of us have a degree, it makes sense to have two'（在通才时代唯有专精知识技能才能获利，研究生收入高出40%，拥有两张文凭才合情合理）。D选项 further their studies in a specific field（在特定领域进一步深造/攻读更高学位）完美契合原文要求攻读研究生、获取专门知识的建议。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: have specific knowledge or skills + Postgraduates earn 40% more + have two degrees = further their studies in a specific field。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 建议题核心概念对应：specific knowledge + postgraduates 转换为 further studies in a specific field。

stem: What can be concluded about Generation Z from the last two paragraphs?

options.text: Lifelong learning will define them.
options.analysis: 【正确项 · 全文主旨高度升华】P6-S1 和 P7-S1 明确总结 Z 世代的核心本质特征：'they will need to be constantly up-skilling throughout their career to stay employable... work for 17 employers... have five different careers. Education... will be a core part... degree won't define them'（在整个职业生涯中持续技能升级，历经17家雇主与5种职业，持续教育贯穿一生，单张文凭无法定义他们）。A选项 Lifelong learning will define them（终身学习将真正定义他们）以最精炼深刻的哲理概括了最后两段的核心结论。

options.text: They will make qualified educators.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 职业偏差】未提及成为合格的教育工作者。

options.text: Degrees will no longer appeal to them.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 过于绝对】文凭依然有价值（第5段建议读研），只是不再神圣化且无法单一定义人生。

options.text: They will have a limited choice of jobs.
options.analysis: 【干扰特征: 事实相反】他们一生将经历17家雇主和5种截然不同的职业（five different careers），选择极其多元丰富，绝非有限（limited）。

methodologyReview.trapAnalysis: constantly up-skilling throughout career + Education core part of trajectory + degree won't define them = Lifelong learning will define them。
methodologyReview.methodSummary: 尾段主旨升华题：抓准 constantly up-skilling throughout career 抽象概括为 Lifelong learning。
